## Ship Detect

Locate ships in rendered scenes containing visual distractors.

Train from 5,000 labeled renders and exploit supplied unlabeled images if useful. Whales can resemble targets. The evaluator reads current predictions during the run; scores are hidden.

## Published conditions

Not specified.

The task is counted once; hint variants are not separate problems. This entry records the actual current result-catalog family. Full runnable task assets are not provided by the public website.
